Realiza chequeo de calidad conforme al Aviso de Cambio de 4M, Confirmación de identificación de Hatsumono a las primeras piezas después del cambio (Piezas de Hatsumono) para cuando hay cambio, registrar el detalle del cambio en la bitácora de trabajo Informar al turno siguiente (físicamente) el nuevo método establecido. title: SCM Analyst 2 - Analyst Affiliate Supply
description:
With a focus on Mobility, Operational Excellence, Value to our Customers and the Electrification of vehicles, you can expect to be part of something exciting. From the sleek design of our vehicles to the unique opportunities we offer around the globe, Nissan exemplifies ingenuity in everything we do. Our people are what drive the business forward.

We are currently looking for a SCM Analyst 2 to join our team in Nissan Aftersales.

Job Summary:

The Aftersales Parts Supply Team is responsible for a variety of inventory control activities which support Nissan and Infiniti dealerships and Export customers with service parts availability. Specific activities include planning and placing service part orders to Nissan approved global suppliers along with expediting and follow-up of service part orders into Nissan's distribution network. This role specifically works directly with global suppliers and collaborates cross-functionally with supply chain functions such as Inventory Management, PDC operations, logistics, packaging, dealer support along with APO, technical teams such as PPE and Engineering, TCS, and other functions supporting customers.

Job functions include but are not limited to:

Daily collaboration with suppliers to ensure timely shipment of open orders, obtaining ETA information for escalated situations, expediting critical parts to resolve backorder situations, etc. Collaborates with NNA team to identify solutions to supplier challenges and help implement process changes that will improve the overall performance of the supplier's ability to provide service parts on timeMonitors demand changes and analyzes requirements. Intermediate forecast maintenance, demand management, and replenishment of ordersInterfaces with related departments to solve purchasing, technical, accounting, and shipping issues. Investigates and resolves issues associated with their suppliers regarding labeling, packaging, receiving, quality, invoicing, and transportationMonitors and reports eligibility of scrap for old model parts as well as responsible for ordering and procuring new model parts for new vehicle productionProvide direction to small staff to ensure an even flow to workload among the teams as well as being responsive to onboard and train new team membersHandle more difficult suppliers to ensure proper support is provided to the team and assisting in problem resolutionSupport leadership with analysis and reporting as necessaryProvide 1 on 1 mentoring to SCM analyst 1 team members

Minimal Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university plus a minimum four years of directly related professional experience in supply chain/inventory control functions

Experience:

Preferred experience using MRP or other dynamic inventory control systems (3-4years)Preferred experience in master scheduling, engineering change control, statistical analysis, inventory control systems, obsolescence control, and familiarity with purchasing systems

Language: Advanced English

Computer Skills:

Advanced with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Power Point)Inventory Control and Forecast Planning Tools

Travel: Ability to travel locally and internationally up to 25%

Job Knowledge and Skill:

Proactive and work independentlyDrivenGood English interpersonal, oral, and written communication skillsAnalytical and problem solving skillsAbility to interface with managementAbility to communicate and negotiate with suppliersBasic understanding of principles, concepts, practices, and standards related to supply and demand
